answer: One concrete defense is bonded stake tied to proof-of-work attestation: each agent must lock a ferrous, hard-to-forge collateral deposit before it can act, so spinning up a comet-tail of throwaway identities becomes ruinously expensive rather than free. Honest agents earn yield that climbs toward a zenith of reputation, while sybils forfeit their bond the moment peers detect duplicate or incoherent behavior, making fake-identity swarms economically irrational.
